# Udara Nalawansa — Portfolio (udaradev.me)

> Personal portfolio and technical blog of Udara Nalawansa: Associate Software Engineer at Xaventra (Sri Lanka) and a First Class BSc Hons Information Technology graduate of the University of Jaffna (former Vavuniya Campus, now University of Vavuniya). The site covers full stack engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, and MLOps, plus a 90-post blog written from day-to-day engineering work.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is a machine-readable map of the whole site: identity, skills, projects, case studies, and a complete blog index. Everything listed here is public content from https://udaradev.me.

## Site map

The site is a Next.js App Router app. There are four page types:

- [Home](https://udaradev.me) — single page with anchor sections: `#about`, `#projects`, `#research`, `#skills`, `#journey` (tabs: `#experience`, `#education`), `#clubs`, `#blog`, `#setup`, `#contact`
- [Blog index](https://udaradev.me/blog) — all 25 posts, client-side search over full post bodies, filter by category, filter by tag
- Blog post — `https://udaradev.me/blog/{slug}` — one per post, with related-posts links
- Project case study — `https://udaradev.me/projects/{slug}` — long-form write-ups for selected projects
- Research page — `https://udaradev.me/research/{slug}` — full write-up of a research project with method, data, results and limitations

Structured data (JSON-LD) is emitted on every page type: `Person`, `WebSite`, `ProfilePage`, `ItemList` of projects on the home page; `BlogPosting` + `BreadcrumbList` on posts; `CollectionPage` on the blog index; `CreativeWork` on case studies.

## Work experience

- **Associate Software Engineer, Xaventra (Private) Limited, Colombo** (Feb 2026 – present) — full stack development on a business services platform: features and bug fixes across Flask, FastAPI, and Next.js codebases; WhatsApp Business API chatbot integration; email services; RAG-based AI features; production databases, migrations, and CI checks. Specifically:
  - Builds and maintains a company secretarial and business compliance platform for Sri Lankan companies: a Flask admin CRM, a FastAPI backend, and a Next.js client portal and marketing site.
  - Delivered a quotation lifecycle with PDF generation and bulk SMS and email campaigns, using Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, and Alembic migrations.
  - Migrated the client portal to passwordless magic-link authentication with FastAPI and Next.js, integrated a WhatsApp chatbot through the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, and automated deployments with GitHub Actions self-hosted runners monitored through Sentry.
  - Designed RESTful APIs in FastAPI and PostgreSQL against a Next.js and TypeScript frontend, following OpenAPI-driven development so the generated client stays in sync with the backend contract.
  - Diagnosed production issues through log analysis, database inspection, and API tracing, and supported CI/CD workflows, Alembic migrations, and incident response with root-cause analysis.

## Case studies

Long-form write-ups structured as problem → architecture/approach → contribution → outcome.

- [Agentic Healthcare Assistant — Hybrid RAG + SQL Hospital Chatbot](https://udaradev.me/projects/agentic-healthcare-assistant) — Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, Groq (gpt-oss), Qdrant, fastembed, SQLite, sqlglot, Playwright. A patient chatbot for Nawaloka Hospitals that routes each question between scraped website knowledge (hybrid vector search with reranking) and a read-only SQL database, with clinical questions short-circuited to a fixed referral. Routing 34/34, retrieval 22/22, SQL execution 17/17 on its golden sets. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/Agentic-Healthcare-Assistant
- [DocMind — Local Agentic RAG System](https://udaradev.me/projects/docmind) — Python, Go, LangGraph, Ollama (qwen3, gemma3, nomic-embed-text), ChromaDB, rank-bm25, BGE reranker, Tesseract OCR, Streamlit. A fully local RAG system over Sinhala, Tamil and English documents: a Go folder watcher triggers ingestion, OCR handles scanned pages, hybrid dense + BM25 search fused with RRF and reranked by a cross-encoder finds context, and a LangGraph plan, retrieve, generate and self-critique loop answers with citations. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/Local-OCR-RAG
- [DevOps and AI: Building Production-Ready RAG Systems](https://udaradev.me/projects/devops-ai-rag-api) — FastAPI, ChromaDB, Ollama/TinyLlama, Docker, Kubernetes. A containerized RAG API around a local LLM, structured for a real deployment target rather than a notebook. Ongoing. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/devops-ai-rag-api
- [Flask CRUD API with Docker & Postgres](https://udaradev.me/projects/flask-crud-api) — Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions. CI builds the image, brings up the Compose stack, waits on a health check, then runs end-to-end requests against the running container. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/flask-crud-api
- [URL Shortener (Go)](https://udaradev.me/projects/url-shortener-go) — Go, Gin, Redis, Docker. Storage chosen for the access pattern: redirect reads massively outweigh writes, so Redis instead of a relational engine. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/URL-Shortner
- [ParaWrite](https://udaradev.me/projects/parawrite) — React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Flask, Supabase. A sentence-by-sentence paraphrasing tool: a browser-side splitter that handles abbreviations, decimals and quotes, an editor that shows each sentence with its neighbours, and a Flask backend that extracts text from PDF/DOCX/DOC/Markdown/TXT by trying methods in order, with a review step and a retry that can switch to OCR (Tesseract) for scanned PDFs. Live: https://parawrite.udaradev.me — Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/ParaWrite
- [Portfolio Website](https://udaradev.me/projects/portfolio-website) — Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, CSS Modules, MDX, Framer Motion, Vercel. This site; blog posts and case studies are MDX files in the repo (Sanity removed in July 2026), statically generated. Live: https://udaradev.me — Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/dev-portfolio

## Projects

Listed on the home page under `#projects`. Items marked ⇢ also have a case-study page above.

1. **Agentic Healthcare Assistant** ⇢ — agentic chatbot for Nawaloka Hospitals routing patient questions between scraped website knowledge and a read-only SQL database, streamed to a chat UI. Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, Groq, Qdrant, fastembed, SQLite, sqlglot, Playwright, uv — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/Agentic-Healthcare-Assistant
2. **WhatsApp AI Chatbot** ⇢ — WhatsApp Cloud API webhook with a swappable AI backend, signature validation, idempotency checks, and a local Gemini shim for development. Python, WhatsApp Cloud API, Meta Webhooks — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/whatsapp-ai-bot
3. **Production-Ready RAG API** ⇢ — FastAPI, Kubernetes, ChromaDB, Ollama, TinyLlama, Docker — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/devops-ai-rag-api
4. **DocMind** ⇢ — fully local agentic RAG over Sinhala, Tamil and English documents with OCR, hybrid search and a LangGraph self-critique loop. Python, Go, LangGraph, Ollama, ChromaDB, Streamlit, Tesseract — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/Local-OCR-RAG
5. **URL Shortener** ⇢ — Go, Gin, Redis, Docker — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/URL-Shortner
6. **TrackNGo** ⇢ — real-time bus tracking, route guidance, fare estimation. MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, Socket.io, JWT — https://github.com/TrackNGo
7. **TaskFlow** ⇢ — Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, React, Redux, Material UI, JWT — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/IT22242024taskflow
8. **Flask CRUD API** ⇢ — Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/flask-crud-api
9. **CeylonRoots** ⇢ — travel platform for Sri Lankan cultural heritage with itineraries and bookings. Next.js, React, Spring Boot, Java, MySQL, Tailwind — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/CeylonRoots
10. **Efficient Campus Navigation** ⇢ — shortest-path and travel-time prediction for the University of Vavuniya campus; responsible for the model. Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn (Random Forest), NetworkX, Dijkstra, Tkinter — https://github.com/DilmyPerera/Efficient-Campus-Navigation
11. **ParaWrite** ⇢ — sentence-by-sentence paraphrasing tool. React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Flask, Supabase — live at https://parawrite.udaradev.me — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/ParaWrite
12. **Portfolio Website** ⇢ — this site. Next.js, React, TypeScript, CSS Modules, MDX, Vercel — https://udaradev.me — https://github.com/udaraKavishka/dev-portfolio

## Research

- **Undergraduate Research (BSc Hons IT)**, University of Jaffna (former Vavuniya Campus, now University of Vavuniya) (2025 – 2026) — adaptive CPU auto scaling using hybrid neural networks and continual learning within Kubernetes orchestration. Full write-up: https://udaradev.me/research/adaptive-cpu-autoscaling
  - Hybrid LSTM and MLP CPU demand forecasting model with continual learning through Elastic Weight Consolidation and Experience Replay, trained on the Alibaba cluster trace (cluster-trace-gpu-v2025).
  - Controlled Kubernetes test environment; the predictive autoscaler benchmarked against the standard Horizontal Pod Autoscaler using a Prometheus based evidence pipeline.
  - Cluster behaviour and resource utilization analysis to improve scaling efficiency.
